text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as Fuji Kiseki was walking down 
the hallway...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Ouch. What is this... muscle soreness? 
But I shouldn't have sore muscles here..."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I've got a bad feeling about this... For 
now, I should report to Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, worrying everyone won't help. First, I 
need to get checked out in the nurse's 
office...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... we need to talk. Actually, 
earlier today, a sudden pain shot through 
my leg...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So I went to the infirmary to get checked 
out, but... the results were—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Looking at that face, it looks like 
the surprise was a success.
choice_data_list: That surprise was bad for my heart...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, sorry. Well, I panicked a bit at 
first too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"First of all, I've been dancing for a 
long time, so I rarely get muscle 
soreness, and on top of that, it was a 
spot that had never ached before."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that part got sore... Which means 
I'm steadily building muscles that dance 
practice can't train...”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to a certain someone 
guiding me so accurately♪
choice_data_list: I see. If you say so, then that's fine.
I see, well if you say so.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, this whole thing was a good learning 
experience for me too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Opening unknown doors so I can dance even 
more gracefully upon the turf... I look 
forward to continuing our work together, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are still areas she can hone. It 
seems Fuji Kiseki has learned this lesson 
well.
